definitions.gloss: complimentary ticket; invitation ticket; free pass
definitions.explanation: A ticket given free of charge, typically for events, exhibitions, movies, or shows. Often distributed for promotional purposes or to invited guests.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{招待券|しょうたいけん}をもらった。
examples.english: I received a complimentary movie ticket.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}の{招待券|しょうたいけん}が{二枚|にまい}ある。
examples.english: I have two complimentary tickets to the art museum.

examples.japanese: {懸賞|けんしょう}に{当|あ}たって、テーマパークの{招待券|しょうたいけん}をもらったので、{家族|かぞく}で{行|い}くことにした。
examples.english: I won a prize and got complimentary theme park tickets, so we decided to go as a family.

notes:
A free ticket given as an invitation or promotional giveaway. Composed of {招待|しょうたい} (invitation) + {券|けん} (ticket/voucher).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {招待券|しょうたいけん}をもらう: to receive a complimentary ticket
- {招待券|しょうたいけん}を{配|くば}る: to distribute invitation tickets
- {映画|えいが}の{招待券|しょうたいけん}: complimentary movie ticket
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}の{招待券|しょうたいけん}: exhibition invitation ticket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無料券|むりょうけん}: free ticket/coupon — general term for any free pass
- {優待券|ゆうたいけん}: discount/preferential ticket — offered to shareholders or members at reduced prices
- {入場券|にゅうじょうけん}: admission ticket — a paid ticket for entry
- {招待状|しょうたいじょう}: invitation letter/card — a written invitation, not a ticket

USAGE:
In Japan, {招待券|しょうたいけん} are commonly given away through magazine sweepstakes, promotional campaigns, corporate events, or as perks at workplaces.
